title: Fig Makes a Gift for Nell
checkpoint: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Fig wants to make a gift for Nell.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting on a leaf, thinking, with a small empty spot beside him for a gift.

pages.text: Fig looks for bits along the garden path.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar crawling slowly along a path dotted with small puddles, looking for things.

pages.text: Fig finds a smooth white stone.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar next to a small, smooth white stone beside a puddle.

pages.text: Fig finds a bright yellow petal.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar beside a single bright yellow flower petal lying on the path.

pages.text: Fig finds a thin, curly twig.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar next to a thin, curly twig on the puddle path.

pages.text: Fig sets the bits in a neat little row.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar arranging the white stone, yellow petal and curly twig in a tidy row on a leaf.

pages.text: Fig ties the gift with a bit of grass.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar wrapping a thin blade of grass around the little row of objects.

pages.text: Fig brings the gift to Nell.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar carrying the small bundled gift towards Nell the bee.

pages.text: Nell looks at the gift and grins.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee looking closely at the gift, grinning with delight.

pages.text: Nell is glad to have such a good friend.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Fig the caterpillar sitting together on the leaf with the gift between them.
